description: Manage your eBay seller account: inventory, listings, orders and business policies.

ebay_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order (sale) on your eBay seller account, with its buyer, items and total, ready for 'Mark order shipped'. Orders already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.buyer: The buyer, with their eBay username.
output.lineItems: What was bought: each item's title, SKU and quantity.
output.orderId: The order's ID, for the other eBay steps.
output.orderPaymentStatus: Whether it is paid, such as PAID or PENDING.
output.pricingSummary: The order's subtotal, delivery cost, tax and total.
output.salesRecordReference: Seller Hub's record number, if you use it.
